summary: Onda 1 (transaction-details DTO dedup, QUERY_KEYS PT->EN rename, TransactionTipo->TransactionType rename) validated clean in its stated scope. Evidence: tsc --noEmit -p . in apps/api -> only the 3 documented pre-existing baseline errors (audiovisual.dto.spec.ts, integrations.dto.spec.ts, integrations.oauth-security.spec.ts), unrelated to this wave. tsc --noEmit in packages/types -> 0 errors. tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json in apps/web -> 48 errors, all within the documented frozen Artist-domain baseline list (Artists.tsx, FonogramaFormModal.tsx, ObraFormModal.tsx, ParticipanteViewModal.tsx, RegistroMusicas.tsx, Dashboard.tsx, loadArtistContext.ts, LancamentoViewModal.tsx, SharePendenteFormModal.tsx, ShareViewModal.tsx) plus useOperationalSettings.test.tsx which is untracked/unrelated pre-existing settings-module debt outside all 4 wave-touched areas -- no NEW error was introduced by this wave's changes. npx jest transactions in apps/api -> 20/20 passing (2 suites), matches expected baseline. Grep confirmed zero residual references to TransactionTipo/TransacaoTipo anywhere in apps/api, apps/web, packages/types. Grep confirmed zero references to any of the 26 legacy PT QUERY_KEYS names (ARTISTAS, TRANSACOES, FUNCIONARIOS, etc.) anywhere in apps/web/src outside the rename. packages/types/dist was confirmed rebuilt with TransactionType (both .d.ts and .js). transaction-details.dto.ts / transactions.service.ts / form-to-payload.mapper.ts / TransacaoViewModal.tsx read/diffed directly: no PT+EN duplicate field survives (tipo/tipoTransacao/type collapsed to type; amount/valor collapsed to valor; description/descricao collapsed to descricao; etc.), and the form-to-payload.mapper.ts rename is verified correct against the actual Zod schema in transacao.validator.ts (camelCase field names and quantidadeParcelas:string type now match, whereas the prior snake_case keys were silently dropped by Zod strip). Migration proposal file 20260910900001_PROPOSAL_BackfillArtistGoalStatusToEnglish.ts confirmed NOT registered in migrations/index.ts (grep count 0) and is untracked (never executed). git diff --check shows only CRLF line-ending warnings, no real whitespace/conflict-marker issues. One LOW finding filed (find-3a2a4208) for a pre-existing (not introduced by this wave) PT-BR value string left on an already-English QUERY_KEYS.FINANCIAL_RULES key. No other findings. Onda 1 is clean within its declared strict scope.
